mechanics.name: Five Moves Ahead
mechanics.currentEffect: While you are being chased by the Killer or are inside the Killer's Terror Radius, you see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets and Windows and perform the Pallet Drop interaction 50% faster. Dropping a Pallet puts the perk on a 40/35/30-second cooldown.
activation: You must be in a chase or inside the Killer's Terror Radius to receive the active effects.
mechanics.patchNote: Live 9.5.0 release uses a 40/35/30-second cooldown after dropping a Pallet. The 10.2 PTB would remove Windows from the aura list and describe the pallet benefit as starting movement 50% earlier; those changes are not live.

editorial.summary: In chase or the Terror Radius, see the five closest pallets and windows and recover from pallet drops faster, with a cooldown after each drop.
useCases: Route toward remaining resources once a chase starts.
Make pallet drops safer against ranged and zoning Killers.
Create extra distance after a stun or forced pallet break.
counters: Dropping a pallet starts a 40/35/30-second cooldown.
The aura information is unavailable outside chase and the Killer's Terror Radius.
Killers such as The Nurse can reduce the value of pallet-focused routing.
pros: Combines chase information with a real pallet-interaction advantage.
Particularly strong for experienced players who already know window locations.
Useful against a very wide range of Killers.
cons: Less beginner-friendly than always-on Windows of Opportunity.
Cooldown can remove the information immediately after a pallet is used.
Its aura component is on 10.2 patch watch.
analysis: Five Moves Ahead lands directly behind our top-ten utility core because it does more than show yellow objects. The information is narrower than Windows of Opportunity, but the pallet-drop benefit can change whether a Killer gets a hit at the exact moment a Survivor commits to a pallet.

That secondary effect matters most against Killers who punish the pallet-drop animation. Ranged and zoning powers can often threaten a hit while the Survivor is locked into the drop. Five Moves Ahead shortens that vulnerable interaction enough to create dodges, crouches, or extra distance that would otherwise be unavailable.

The tradeoff is consistency. Windows is always active and shows the broader resource picture, which is why it remains higher for the full player base. Five Moves Ahead asks you to already understand the map well enough to use a limited chase-only snapshot, and every pallet drop turns the perk off for a while.

Current community discussion in 2026 repeatedly treats Five Moves Ahead as one of the strongest chase-information perks, especially for experienced players. It is also explicitly changing on the 10.2 PTB, so this #11 placement is for live 10.1.2a only.
editorial.verdict: A-tier and one of the best chase perks in the current live game. Windows is the better universal learning tool; Five Moves Ahead has the stronger pallet-specific ceiling once your map knowledge catches up.
